verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no account-level or bulk data export feature, and no export to open formats. File read/list APIs are developer building blocks for pulling files out of individual sandboxes. The open-source, self-hostable infrastructure is an adjacent exit path, not an export capability, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
